course_name_original: Mini-projetos de sistemas de aprendizagem e controlo
course_name_en: Mini-projects in learning and control systems

learning_outcomes.text: Explanation of the basic functioning of simple learning and control algorithms
Development of small projects using Python program modules on the Colab notebook platform that includes data processing and attribute extraction, learning and control
Development of soft skills in the areas of teamwork, cooperation, peer communication, time management, resource management and stress management.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to basic concepts of machine learning systems for detection and classification.
Introduction to the basic concepts of control systems.
Basic principles of a complete system of data/signal acquisition, data processing and attribute extraction, learning and control.
Development and testing of learning and control mini-projects using simple modules programmed in python on the Colab notebook platform.
teaching_methods: Lectures to expose machine learning subjects and control systems, accompanied by examples and demonstrations.
Practical-laboratory work focused on the development of learning and control mini-projects.
assessment_rules: The final classification is calculated from two components: EIW (Exercises proposed as Individual Work in the form of a mini-test) and TL (Laboratory Work). The formula for the final classification is 15% EIW + 85% TL. Active participation in the proposed activities is required for eligibility.
bibliography: strm, K. J., & Murray, R. M.; Feedback systems., Princeton university press.
Mller, A. C., & Guido, S.; Introduction to machine learning with Python: a guide for data scientists.
